trial_court: Court of Shri Mukesh Kumar Gupta, District Judge (Commercial)-07, District Central Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
case_name: Icici Bank Limited vs Dhirendra Kumar Singh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: ICICI Bank Ltd, Through Its Authorized Representative Pankaj Jain
parties.respondent_defendant: Dhirendra Kumar Singh, S/o Mr. Shyam Sunder Singh, Manager, Emp ID-4961, C/o. Bhageera Construction Pvt. Ltd.

facts_of_case: The plaintiff bank sought recovery of Rs.5,32,195/- alongwith interest thereon @ 24% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till its realization.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to enforce a contract to prove that the contract was validly entered into.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking to enforce a contract to prove that the contract was validly entered into.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to comply with the terms and conditions of a loan agreement can result in legal consequences.
legal_principles.held: The defendant failed to comply with the terms and conditions of the loan agreement and failed to pay the outstanding amount.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff bank was granted recovery of Rs.5,32,195/- alongwith interest thereon @ 24% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till its realization.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for recovery of debt
defending against a cheque bounce case
